faqs.question: How does Cove & Stone approach custom pool design?
faqs.answer: Each pool is developed as a custom architectural response to the home's geometry, the property and the way the space will be used. The design process coordinates the pool, surrounding materials and outdoor-living elements into one clear direction.

faqs.question: Can a spa be integrated with a custom pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. A pool concept can include an integrated or raised spa, sun shelves and other connected water elements when they fit the property and the overall design.

faqs.question: What pool features can be included in a design?
faqs.answer: Depending on the property and design direction, features may include infinity-edge, zero-edge or perimeter-overflow concepts, waterfalls, sheer descents, bubblers, fire-and-water features, lighting, equipment upgrades and automation.

faqs.question: How are pool finishes and materials selected?
faqs.answer: Selections are coordinated around the architecture and palette of the home. Options can include porcelain, marble, travertine, natural stone, glass tile and other premium interior, coping and decking finishes.

faqs.question: Can I review a 3D visualization of my pool concept?
faqs.answer: The design studio can develop a photorealistic 3D visualization so the layout, materials and relationship to the home can be reviewed before construction begins.

faqs.question: Can I review pool materials at the Jacksonville showroom?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Jacksonville design studio and showroom provides a place to review pool finishes, waterline tile, stone, pavers, coping, outdoor kitchens, fire and water features, and lighting.

faqs.question: Does Cove & Stone coordinate engineering and permitting?
faqs.answer: Engineering coordination and permitting requirements are reviewed as part of project planning. Specific requirements depend on the property, scope and applicable local jurisdiction.

faqs.question: Are financing options available for a custom pool?
faqs.answer: Financing options may be available through current lender programs and financing partners. Availability is subject to credit approval, lender terms and program requirements; Cove & Stone does not guarantee approval, rates, payments or loan terms.

/renovations.title: Pool Renovation & Remodeling Jacksonville, FL | Cove & Stone
/renovations.description: Modernize a pool in Jacksonville and Northeast Florida with resurfacing, tile and coping updates, decking, structural corrections, equipment and automation upgrades, and complete pool transformations.

faqs.question: When is it time to consider a pool renovation?
faqs.answer: Renovation can be considered when a pool has aging surfaces, damaged tile or coping, outdated equipment, structural concerns, or a layout that no longer suits the home or the way the space is used.

faqs.question: What is the difference between resurfacing and a complete remodel?
faqs.answer: Resurfacing renews the pool's interior finish. A broader remodel can coordinate surface work with tile, coping, decking, equipment, structural corrections, layout changes and additional water or outdoor-living features.

faqs.question: Can a renovation add a spa, sun shelf or water feature?
faqs.answer: A renovation concept may include a raised or integrated spa, sun shelf, zero-edge element, waterfall, sheer descent, bubbler or fire-and-water feature when the property and existing structure support the design.

faqs.question: Can you update the pool's coping, tile and decking?
faqs.answer: Yes. Aging tile, coping and decking can be reviewed as part of the renovation scope, with material selections such as glass tile, porcelain, marble, travertine, natural stone and other premium finishes.

faqs.question: Can pool equipment and automation be upgraded?
faqs.answer: Equipment planning can include variable-speed pumps, heating, ozone or UV sanitation systems, lighting and smartphone automation when those upgrades fit the existing system and renovation goals.

faqs.question: Can I see a 3D redesign before renovation work begins?
faqs.answer: The design studio can develop a photorealistic 3D visualization to review the proposed layout, materials and relationship to the home before construction begins.

faqs.question: Can I select renovation materials at the Jacksonville showroom?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Jacksonville design studio and showroom provides a place to review pool finishes, waterline tile, stone, pavers, coping, outdoor kitchens, fire and water features, and lighting.

faqs.question: Does Cove & Stone coordinate renovation engineering and permitting?
faqs.answer: Engineering coordination and permitting requirements are reviewed during project planning. Specific requirements depend on the existing pool, renovation scope, property and applicable local jurisdiction.

faqs.question: Are financing options available for pool remodeling?
faqs.answer: Financing options may be available through current lender programs and financing partners. Availability is subject to credit approval, lender terms and program requirements; Cove & Stone does not guarantee approval, rates, payments or loan terms.
